summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 3+4 testing for YABBAI platform scaling implementation. All new backend endpoints (settings, analytics, missions, transactions, price-history, treasury-snapshots, events) tested and working. Frontend Settings and Analytics pages fully functional with ToastProvider integration, Recharts visualizations, and backend data fetching. Fixed minor ObjectId serialization bug in POST endpoints. All 13 routes accessible and navigation working correctly.

fixed_bugs.issue: 500 error due to ObjectId serialization - MongoDB inserts add _id field with ObjectId which FastAPI cannot serialize
fixed_bugs.fix: Added doc.pop('_id', None) before returning response to remove ObjectId field

minor_warnings.issue: Console warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> - minor hydration warning

Backend: Transactions endpoints (GET, POST) - records transactions with sweep type, lists with sorting
Backend: Price history endpoints (GET, POST) - adds price snapshots, retrieves history with mint filter
Backend: Treasury snapshots endpoints (GET, POST) - adds snapshots with SOL and USD values, retrieves chronologically
Backend: Events endpoints (GET, POST) - logs events with color and category, retrieves with limit
Backend: Analytics aggregate endpoint (GET) - returns tx_count, mission_count, total_swept_sol, latest_price, latest_treasury_sol
